works.title: Small Memory Software: Patterns for Systems with Limited Memory
works.note: The pattern catalog for constrained-memory design; names and teaches the bulk of this route's small-memory elements.

works.title: Pattern-Oriented Software Architecture Vol. 3: Patterns for Resource Management
works.note: The dedicated resource-management pattern language: acquisition, lifecycle, and release patterns of this route.

works.title: Pattern-Oriented Software Architecture Vol. 2: Patterns for Concurrent and Networked Objects
works.authors: Douglas Schmidt, Michael Stal, Hans Rohnert, Frank Buschmann
works.note: Names Component Configurator (dynamic linking/unlinking and lifecycle control of components).

works.title: Real-Time Design Patterns; Doing Hard Time; Real-Time UML
works.note: Real-Time Design Patterns names the embedded memory-pattern set (Fixed Sized Buffer, Pool/Static Allocation, Smart Pointer, Garbage Collection).

works.title: Design Patterns for Embedded Systems in C: An Embedded Software Engineering Toolkit
works.note: Ch. 6 memory patterns give C-level implementations of the Douglass memory-pattern set for embedded targets.

works.title: Fluent C: Principles, Practices, and Patterns
works.note: Modern C pattern catalog: memory-management and buffer-ownership patterns of this route are named here.

works.title: C++ Core Guidelines
works.note: Living canonical treatment of C++ resource-management idioms: RAII (R.1), Rule of Three/Five/Zero (C.20/C.21), smart pointers (R.20+), finally/scope guards (E.19).

works.title: TLSF: a New Dynamic Memory Allocator for Real-Time Systems
works.authors: Miguel Masmano, Ismael Ripoll, Alfons Crespo, Jorge Real
works.note: Naming paper of the constant-time two-level segregated fit allocator for real-time systems.

works.title: A Memory Allocator (dlmalloc essay)
works.note: The living essay on general-purpose allocator design; working treatment of boundary tags and binned free lists.

works.title: Embedded Template Library (ETL)
works.note: Living demonstration of heap-free C++: fixed-capacity containers and etl::pool realize static/pool allocation and fixed-size buffers.

works.title: Release It!
works.note: Names the resource-partitioning and resource-hygiene stability patterns Bulkhead and Steady State.

works.title: C Interfaces and Implementations: Techniques for Creating Reusable Software
works.note: The Arena chapter is the classic implementable treatment of arena/region allocation in C.

works.title: EASTL - Electronic Arts Standard Template Library (WG21 N2271)
works.note: Canonical statement of why and how game/embedded C++ replaces standard allocators with custom allocators.

works.title: C++ Software Design: Design Principles and Patterns for High-Quality Software
works.note: Modern catalog-grade treatment of small buffer optimization (type-erasure/SBO chapters).

works.title: Linkers and Loaders
works.note: Standard treatment of memory overlays as a link-time memory-management mechanism.

works.title: Dynamic Storage Allocation: A Survey and Critical Review
works.authors: Paul R. Wilson, Mark S. Johnstone, Michael Neely, David Boles
works.note: The allocator-mechanism survey: free lists, boundary tags, buddy systems, segregated fits in one critical review.

works.title: The Garbage Collection Handbook: The Art of Automatic Memory Management, 2nd ed.
works.authors: Richard Jones, Antony Hosking, Eliot Moss
works.note: The GC canon: tracing vs reference counting, mark-compact, read/write barriers, weak references; anchor for all GC-side elements. Verified via gchandbook.org (official site) + Crossref DOI record (2023-06-01).

works.title: The Slab Allocator: An Object-Caching Kernel Memory Allocator
works.note: Naming paper of the slab allocator (SunOS 5.4 object-caching kernel allocator). USENIX page 403s to fetchers; identity verified via dblp record conf/usenix/Bonwick94 (title/author/venue/pages/year).

works.title: The Art of Computer Programming, Volume 1: Fundamental Algorithms, 3rd ed.
works.note: Sec. 2.5 Dynamic Storage Allocation is the naming source of the buddy system and the boundary-tag method. Verified via InformIT publisher page.

works.title: Hazard Pointers: Safe Memory Reclamation for Lock-Free Objects
works.venue: IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems 15(6), pp. 491-504
works.note: Canonical naming paper of hazard pointers for safe memory reclamation in lock-free structures. Verified via live doi.org resolution of 10.1109/TPDS.2004.8 + dblp record journals/tpds/Michael04.

works.title: Practical lock-freedom
works.venue: University of Cambridge Computer Laboratory, Technical Report UCAM-CL-TR-579
works.note: Naming source of epoch-based reclamation for lock-free data structures. Verified via the Cambridge CL technical-report page (Feb 2004, 116 pp.).

works.title: Game Engine Architecture, 4th ed.
works.note: The game-engine canon: engine memory systems (stack/arena, pool, custom allocators) and streaming resource management. Verified via gameenginebook.com (official site; 4th ed., two-volume set).

works.title: Smalltalk Best Practice Patterns
works.note: Naming source of Execute Around Method, the block-based resource-bracketing idiom. Verified via InformIT publisher page (published Oct 3, 1996).

works.title: Pattern-Oriented Software Architecture Vol. 4: A Pattern Language for Distributed Computing
works.authors: Frank Buschmann, Kevlin Henney, Douglas C. Schmidt
works.unresolved: publisher-page confirmation: Wiley and O'Reilly pages returned 403 this session; details match the Open Library catalog record (Wiley, May 2007, ISBN 9780470059029)
works.note: Consolidates Object Manager and Lookup into the POSA pattern language; catalog-grade home for the EuroPLoP 2003 Object Manager pattern.

works.title: Implement a Dispose method (.NET documentation)
works.note: The official living specification of the dispose pattern (IDisposable, Dispose(bool), SafeHandle). Verified via live load of the Microsoft Learn page.

works.title: Optimize control performance (WPF documentation, UI virtualization)
works.note: Official doc defining UI/list virtualization and container recycling (VirtualizingStackPanel). Verified via live load of the Microsoft Learn page.

works.title: The Design and Evolution of C++
works.note: Naming source of RAII (resource acquisition is initialization), from the language's designer. Verified via stroustrup.com/dne.html (author's page).

works.title: Simplify Your Exception-Safe Code - Forever (ScopeGuard)
works.note: Naming article of the ScopeGuard idiom (also circulated as the Dr. Dobb's 'Generic<Programming>: Change the Way You Write Exception-Safe Code - Forever'). Verified via Alexandrescu's own article listing at erdani.org.

notes: All 56 route elements are covered by >=1 catalog-grade work; no gaps. Heavy membership reuse as expected: 16 memberships (noblesmallmem and posa3 as anchors, plus posa2, both Douglass corpora, preschern, coreguidelines, tlsf, dlmalloc, etl, nygard, hanson, eastl, iglberger, levine, wilsonsurvey). 12 new works, 11 verified live this session, 1 unverified (posa4: Wiley/O'Reilly 403; Open Library record matches). Judgment calls per seed guidance: (a) TAOCP vol. 1 included alongside the Wilson survey because it is the naming source of both the buddy system and boundary tags; (b) Collins (CACM 1960) omitted - the GC Handbook 2nd ed. is the catalog-grade treatment of reference counting and five other GC-side elements, so a single-element 1960 naming paper adds no coverage; (c) region/arena papers (Tofte-Talpin, Gay-Aiken) omitted - hanson (in corpus) names Arenas and gregoryengine gives the modern engine treatment; (d) white skipped: it mentions memory constraints but does not treat this route's elements at catalog grade (would be padding); (e) Gregory verified as the 4th ed. (2026) shown on the official book site - earlier editions carry the same streaming/allocator chapters; (f) dispose-pattern and list-virtualization upgraded from bare doc references to their official living Microsoft Learn pages, both loaded live; (g) bonwickslab and michaelhazard identities confirmed via dblp records (plus live DOI resolution for Michael) after USENIX/IEEE pages returned 403/empty to fetchers.
